data.one_liner: Generator for enum extensions, string conversion, and pattern matching methods.
data.what_it_does: Enhanced Enum generates utility methods for enums such as parsing from strings, mapping naming conventions like snake_case, and adding when/maybeWhen pattern matching capabilities. It uses build_runner to generate the extension code.
use_when: You need to parse enums from string representations easily.
You want pattern matching methods like when() and maybeWhen() on enums.
You need custom naming conventions like snake_case or screamingSnakeCase for enums.
avoid_when: You want to avoid code generation and build_runner dependencies in your project.
strengths: Supports multiple naming conventions out of the box.
Provides built-in pattern matching methods (when, maybeWhen).
Allows custom overrides for individual enum values.
weaknesses: Requires build_runner and code generation setup.
Depends on an extra generator package.
data.setup_notes: Add enhanced_enum to dependencies and enhanced_enum_generator as a dev dependency, then run build_runner.

alternatives.name: freezed_annotation
alternatives.why_pick_it: Freezed also offers advanced union and enum-like code generation features.
